messages:
maria: Heads-up: security is planning a deprecation of legacy TLS/cipher combos across regions. Goal: enforce TLS1.3 and a small set of modern TLS1.2 ciphers. Need to coordinate: KMS cross-region rewraps, proxy RBAC changes, and fill an audit-logging gap in eu-west. Looking for objections and gaps.
kevin: timeline? we need to map which services rely on older clients (mobile sdk, some legacy partners).
maria: target window two-phase: announcement + 30d compatibility, then enforced at +60d. canary in us-west-2 and eu-central first. open to adjusting based on rollout data.
lia: what about customers on older Android devices? we should provide a fallback path for client negotiation, otherwise partner breakages.
maria: agree. plan is: (1) advertise deprecation, (2) enable strict mode on internal proxies only for canary, (3) offer a compatibility proxy route for partners with opt-in. need a policy on how long to support compatibility proxies.
sec-bot: automated-scan: found 14 endpoints in ap-southeast-1 still negotiating TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 (TLS1.2) with weak key-exchange parameters. Recommended: harden ECDHE curves and disallow RSA-KEX.
kevin: KMS question: for cert rotation across regions do we prefer cross-region CMK replication or per-region keys with re-wrap step during rollover? per-region keys avoid KMS cross-account issues but increase operational complexity.
lia: also need to update key policies so our cert-rotation service account can access keys only for rewrap ops. RBAC change must be auditable.
sre-oncall: rollout plan: canary traffic 5% for 24h, measure handshake failures and latency. if failures spike >0.5% revert. who owns the canary? infra/proxy team?
maria: proxy team + infra will own canary. @kevin can you coordinate with proxy owners for config templating and canary flags?
kevin: will do. planning to push nginx tls_profile v3 via config manager. sample snippet for nginx TLS profile: ```
ssl_protocols TLSv1.3 TLSv1.2;
ssl_ciphers 'ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:!aNULL:!eNULL:!DES:!3DES:!RC4';
ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;
```
kevin: that'll help scanners, but double-check mobile compatibility list.
devsec: vuln triage note: we also have outstanding CVE-2023-xxxx in an older TLS library used by partner-proxy. If we deprecate ciphers but don't patch the lib, we still have risk. recommend mandatory library patch before enforcement.
maria: noted. add devsec to triage for partner-proxy. status update expected EOD.
lia: audit logging gap: eu-west log retention for TLS handshakes is only 7 days; compliance wants 90d for TLS handshake metadata (client cert subject, cipher, tls version). who's owner for audit retention policy?
kevin: storage cost jump but we can stream summarized handshake events to long-term audit pipeline (kafka->coldstore) to limit size. need producer changes and schema.
sre-oncall: quick mitigation: enable sampling at 100% for canary hosts and 5% for others until pipeline is ready. remember GDPR PII constraints on client cert subjects — mask where required.
maria: action items: 1) kevin + proxy: templated tls_profile + canary (due 4d) 2) devsec + infra: library patch and vuln triage (due 48h) 3) lia + compliance: auditing retention plan and masking rules (due 1w) 4) maria + security: KMS key policy proposal for rewrap and per-region fallback (due 1w). volunteers for rotation runbook and incident playbook?
kevin: i'll own templating and canary automation.
lia: i'll own audit retention plan with compliance.
devsec: triage team will own vuln patch verification and post-deploy scans.
sre-oncall: i'll write the rollback playbook for canary with clear thresholds.
maria: thanks all. adding doc links and draft runbook in #eng-docs in a few hours. please drop any additional blockers here. :thumbsup:
kevin: one more ask — need a quick command to validate what ciphers a host is offering for QA: ```openssl s_client -connect host:443 -tls1_2 -cipher 'ECDHE' -servername host.example.com```
maria: perfect. if anyone sees partner escalations, tag me immediately and open a high-priority incident if production traffic drops >1%.
sec-bot: note: scheduled cert-rotation job in eu-west is due in 12d, consider aligning enforcement after it to reduce churn.
maria: good catch. we'll adjust the timeline and communicate to affected teams. thanks.
